# Signed Graph Laplacian

The Laplacian of a signed graph.

## Usage

``` r
laplacian_matrix_signed(g, norm = FALSE, sparse = FALSE)
```

## Arguments

- g:

  igraph object with a sign edge attribute.

- norm:

  Whether to calculate the normalized Laplacian. See definitions below.

- sparse:

  Logical scalar, whether to return the result as a sparse matrix. The
  Matrix package is required for sparse matrices.

## Value

a numeric matrix

## Details

See
[laplacian_matrix](https://r.igraph.org/reference/laplacian_matrix.html)
of igraph for more details. In the signed case, D is a diagonal matrix
containing the absolute values of row sums of the signed adjacency
matrix.

## Author

David Schoch

## Examples

``` r
library(igraph)
g <- sample_islands_signed(3, 10, 5 / 10, 1)
laplacian_matrix_signed(g)
```
